description: Source code for MainActivity of an Android app written in Kotlin; sets up UI, navigations, fetches banner and content rail data from API endpoints, handles loading/error states, and navigates to content details.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity handling UI setup, network requests for banners and content rails, user navigation, and error/loading handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up navigation, and begins data fetching for banners and content rails.

methods.name: setupPosterRail
methods.description: Configures a RecyclerView as a horizontal poster rail with spacing and item click callback.

methods.name: openContentInfo
methods.description: Launches ContentInfoActivity with selected item details.

methods.name: fetchAllRails
methods.description: Starts fetching data for all content rails concurrently.

methods.name: setNavColors
methods.description: Updates navigation tab text colors based on active selection.

methods.name: showLoading
methods.description: Displays or hides the banner loading indicator.

methods.name: showError
methods.description: Displays or hides the error container.

methods.name: setBanners
methods.description: Updates the banner carousel with fetched URLs.

methods.name: parseBanners
methods.description: Parses JSON response to extract banner URLs.

methods.name: fetchBanners
methods.description: Performs network request to fetch banner data, manages loading/error states.

methods.name: fetchRail
methods.description: Fetches data for a specific content rail with fallbacks, updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: attemptFetchRail
methods.description: Attempts to fetch rail data from a list of URLs with fallback logic for multiple endpoints.

methods.name: parsePosters
methods.description: Parses JSON response to extract list of poster items (id, name, poster URL).
